item.g:title: Pixel Robot Bluetooth Speaker with Alarm Clock & Wireless Charging - PIXO N73 White, 10 W
item.g:description: PIXO N73 is a white 10 W Bluetooth speaker with a robot-style pixel display, touch-responsive expressions, a digital clock with two alarms, built-in white noise and a sleep timer. Its top wireless charging pad supports compatible phones with up to 15 W output when connected to a suitable power adapter. The internal battery supports portable speaker use; wireless phone charging requires external power. Includes the N73 speaker, charging cable and manual; a wall adapter is not listed. The display includes built-in emoji and music-rhythm effects.
